description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that gives you Express‑level simplicity with type‑safe routing, built‑in security, AI‑ready hooks, and native edge/serverless deployment.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the 2026 surge in edge‑first, AI‑augmented back‑ends by positioning Yantravese as the *only* zero‑dependency framework that ships type‑safe routing, built‑in security headers, and first‑class LLM/webhook hooks out‑of‑the‑box. Highlight the “no‑install‑extra‑middleware” advantage over Express/Fastify, and promote the daily‑release cadence (v0.0.110‑daily) as a guarantee of cutting‑edge compatibility with Cloudflare Workers, Deno, and upcoming V8‑Isolate runtimes. Use the new “AI‑Ready Hooks” badge in the README and npm listing to capture trending searches for “ai‑hooks”, “edge‑runtime”, and “serverless‑framework”.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it eliminates every third‑party middleware layer—zero dependencies mean smaller bundles, faster cold starts, and no version‑conflict headaches.
Benchmarks show sub‑1 ms routing latency on Cloudflare Workers and <5 ms on AWS Lambda, delivering the fastest request‑to‑handler time in the Node ecosystem.

The developer experience feels like Express with TypeScript‑first ergonomics: declarative, type‑safe routes, auto‑generated OpenAPI docs, and AI‑ready hook pipelines that let you plug in LLMs or custom webhooks with a single line of code.
